question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage** suggests Gladolia responded non-verbally to a question.**
 
• **"Shook" **is commonly used to describe** a quick back-and-forth motion of the head, which matches the context of a non-verbal response.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is '**shook**'.

Complete Passage: *At the breakfast table the next morning, there was no sign of my wife. I concluded she was sleeping late, but Gladolia, upon being questioned, only** shook **__her head, mumbled something, and turned the whites of her eyes up to the ceiling. I was glad when the meal was finished and hurried to the library for another try at that story.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

"Adjusted," "rotated," and "stirred" do not fit logically, as they imply different actions that are not typically used to describe a head movement for non-verbal communication.

 
• **Adjusted** (समायोजित किया): "Adjusted" means to change or move something slightly to achieve the desired fit, appearance, or result, which is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **Rotated** (घुमाया): "Rotated" means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center point, which does not fit the context of describing a simple head movement usually intended to convey a response.
 
• **Stirred** (हिलाया): "Stirred" generally means to mix a substance by moving an implement through it, which is not used in the context of head movements or non-verbal gestures.
